multimedia_short_paragraphs.html.note:
Trimmed recording of the page as served on 2026-09-20. The multimedia template puts the body in a DIV carrying m-t-list, not the UL the ordinary template uses, so the class-scoped paragraph path is skipped entirely. What remains is a page-wide fallback that keeps only

longer than 30 characters, and every paragraph this page carries is shorter than that — so a page with real prose and a real photo caption extracted to the empty string. The copyright block is kept in the fixture because it is the one long paragraph on the page, and a fix that reached it instead would look like success.
